name: Chiardmar Steed

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Access You're from Nidal.

---
Your steed is one of the free-spirited wild horses of the Atteran Hills. Your horse animal companion gains a +5 foot status bonus to its Speed and ignores the first 10 feet of difficult terrain it moves through each turn.

---
Special Your horse animal companion can't gain the benefits of a different breed, such as Nidarrmar Steed.
